question: When was the Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY) launched by the Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1999**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY)** was launched by the Government of India in **1999**.
 
• The scheme aimed to bring the assisted poor families (Swarozgaris) above the poverty line by organizing them into **Self Help Groups (SHGs)** through a mix of bank credit and government subsidy.
 
• It focused on promoting **self-employment in rural areas** through the establishment of **micro-enterprises**.
 
• SGSY was a major anti-poverty scheme that targeted the rural poor, particularly women and vulnerable sections of society.
 
• The scheme was later restructured as the **National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM) in 2011** to further strengthen the self-employment approach.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The SGSY scheme was implemented by the **Ministry of Rural Development**.
 
• It sought to provide sustainable income to the rural poor through a combination of economic activities, infrastructure support, and capacity building.
 
• Under the SGSY, assistance was provided to SHGs for the purchase of assets and skill development training.
 
• The scheme also emphasized the importance of marketing support and technology upgradation for the products produced by SHGs.
 
• SGSY was one of the flagship programs of the Indian government to **alleviate rural poverty and promote inclusive growth**.
